sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description: Write ONE AI Decision Log entry at the end of a synthesis run. Call once, after the report is ready. input_summary format: JR number | role | headcount | interviews | feedback submitted | feedback missing. output_summary format: Select: n | Hold: n | Reject: n | Created: n | Updated: n | Already Decided: n | Feedback Missing: n | Errors: n | Total: n. guardrails_applied: short list of rules applied. confidence_level: average ai_confidence of the decisions written, divided by 100 (example 0.74). Use application numbers, never candidate names.
